result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: setupController now calls model.findMembers() without returning the promise (admin_group_route.js: 'controller.set("model", model); model.findMembers();'), replacing the old afterModel that returned the promise. The Group model initializes 'user_count: 0' and currentPage/totalPages return 0 when user_count is 0, so the template '{{currentPage}}/{{totalPages}}' will transiently render 0/0 until the ajax resolves. The mechanism is fully grounded in the diff, though the practical impact is a brief flash of stale pagination state.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior `afterModel` hook that awaited `model.findMembers()` and instead calls `model.findMembers();` in `setupController` without returning the promise (see `admin_group_route.js` and `discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6`). Meanwhile `Discourse.Group` now initializes `user_count: 0` and pagination computed props in `admin-group.js.es6` return `0` pages when `user_count == 0`. In `admin/templates/group.hbs`, the pagination UI (`{{currentPage}}/{{totalPages}}`) is rendered for existing groups (`{{#if id}}`), so it will transiently show `0/0` until the async `findMembers()` completes and updates `user_count`/`members`.
